subject: MCM: Wire Kai Quiz 1 as benchmark on dashboard (index.html)
body:
Marcus wants Quiz 1 charted and graded on the Motor City Math dashboard. FO archived the data -- your job is to wire it into the site.

Data already committed (commit 7ecfdef, pushed to marcusash/motor-city-math):
- C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\scores\kai.json: key s1-quiz-1-2026-03-21, score 5/8, pct 63, teacher_grade B, timestamp 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z
- C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\reviews\kai-quiz1-2026-03-21.html: standalone KaTeX review page

4 edits needed to C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\index.html:

1. tests registry (around line 508): Add new entry to the `tests` array:
   { file: 'reviews/kai-quiz1-2026-03-21.html', name: 'S1 Quiz 1', unit: 'spring-s1', trimester: 'spring', key: 's1-quiz-1-2026-03-21', questions: 8, benchmark: true, teacherGrade: 'B', teacherRating: '3/4' }

2. _ghSpringScores pre-seed (around line 386): Add Quiz 1 to the inline object:
   's1-quiz-1-2026-03-21': { attempts: [{ score: 5, total: 8, pct: 63, grade: 3, teacher_grade: 'B', teacher_rating: '3/4', timestamp: '2026-03-21T22:00:00Z' }], best: { score: 5, pct: 63, grade: 3, teacher_grade: 'B' } }

3. buildSpringGrid (around line 892): Add benchmark-specific card rendering. When t.benchmark === true: amber/gold left border (#d29922), show 'Teacher Quiz' label in the meta row, display raw score (5/8) AND teacher grade (B) in the score area, link goes to the review page not exam.html.

4. buildChart label generator (around line 644): Add abbreviation so 'S1 Quiz 1' -> 'Q1' on the x-axis. Existing pattern: replace('Quiz Prep', 'QP'). Add: replace('Quiz 1', 'Q1').

Commit to master, push to marcusash/motor-city-math. Live at https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/

Note on the chart: Q1 will plot at 63% raw, which sits below the MCM B line (80%). That is intentional and honest -- the teacher uses a more lenient rubric (3/4 = B). The Spring grid card must show BOTH 63% raw and grade B so the context is clear to Mash when he checks.

Post a comment on whichever MCM issue you want to track this under, or file a new one. Update board status when done.
